hero.headline: The Story of Our Freedom Fighters
hero.subheadline: A repository preserving the sacrifices, jail records, and historical manuscripts of Godavari heroes who shook the British Empire.
hero.leadParagraph: From remote riverine hamlets to the dense jungle agency tracts of East and West Godavari, thousands of Telugu freedom fighters sacrificed their lives. From Alluri Sitarama Raju's revolutionary guerrilla rebellion to the Salt Satyagraha prisoners of Rajahmundry Central Jail, this archive preserves every chapter of courage.
hero.featuredQuote: “Even if our blood is shed, we shall not rest until our motherland is free from foreign subjugation.”
